name: com.streethawk.library.geofence.GeofenceService
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Google Play Services starts this StreetHawk Service when a monitored geofence is entered or exited. It reports the transition and makes the matching enter or exit list available to StreetHawk listeners.
disableEffect: StreetHawk geofence events, location-triggered campaigns, and transition reports will stop.
